clue.text: Country rejected Home Counties rule

law means a rule

explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns SELAW round. The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in England's South East.
explanation.definitionFit: A constituent nation of the United Kingdom, so a country.

clue.text: Sea scouts oddly securing role in Hollywood movie

clue.text: Cleric's office reportedly trashed by men at end of service

explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' makes WRECKED sound like RECT; OR is 'other ranks', soldiers; 'end of' takes the last letter of 'service', E.

clue.text: Not original material with gold stuck on back

clue.text: Angry about new Tory faction showing no concern

clue.text: Workmen began grouting walls

clue.text: Playful fool's crime out of order

clue.text: Puzzle of the month for The Listener

clue.text: Teenager nicks bubbly for old folk

clue.text: German author: he has penned article in Der Spiegel

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A lac or lakh is a hundred thousand rupees, an Indian sum of money.

the leading letters of the city name London are L and O

clue.text: Sitter nurses stray creature

clue.text: Busy with homework, up well into the night writing

clue.text: Singular spicy drink

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
hot means spicy

clue.text: Vamp finally lost in crowd after police turned up
